a: Albert Benjamin Simpson yazaalibwa nga 15 Desemba 1843 e Bayview, ku Kizinga kya Prince Edward, mu Kanada, mu maka ag'Abapresbiteri Abasukoti agatya Katonda, gye Ssabbiiti yakuumibwanga n'obwegendereza era ekatekisimu n'eyigibwa amangu; oluvannyuma amaka ne gasengukira ku ttaka mu bugwanjuba bwa Ontario. Ng'akyali muvubuka, ng'asoma nnyo okusukkiridde olw'obuweereza era ng'alumwa endowooza nti tannaba kumanya Katonda gwe yali agenderedde okuweereza, n'amenyeka mu mubiri ne mu mwoyo — omusana ne gujja okuyita mu kitabo eky'edda eky'Abapuritani, ekya Walter Marshall ekiyitibwa "The Gospel Mystery of Sanctification," ekyamugamba nti omwonoonyi ayinza okujja eri Kristo nga bw'ali.

q: Obuweereza bwe obw'olubereberye ng'Omupresbiteri bwali butya?
a: Yeeyambisa yekka okuyita mu Ssomero lya Knox, e Toronto, era ng'akyali muyizi n'awandiika endagaano enzito ey'okwewaayo, ng'awaayo obulamu bwe eri Katonda olw'obuweereza bwonna, okubonaabona oba ssaddaaka yonna eyandisabiddwa. Mu 1865, ng'alina emyaka amakumi abiri mu gumu gyokka, yayitibwa mu Kkanisa lya Knox, e Hamilton — erimu ku bibiina ebisinga obunene mu Kanada — gye mu myaka munaana abantu nga lusanvu mu ataano ne bagattibwako. Mu 1873 yagenda mu Kkanisa ly'Abapresbiteri erya Chestnut Street e Louisville, Kentucky, gye yakubiriza ebibiina ebyali byolekaganye okwegatta mu misomo gy'okubuulira enjiri, era n'ayiga okubuulira olw'okusalawo.

q: Lwaki yaleka ekituuti kye eky'ekitiibwa mu New York?
a: Mu 1879 yajja mu Kkanisa ly'Abapresbiteri erya Thirteenth Street mu Kibuga New York, era amangu n'azitoowererwa okusukka kye yandisobodde olw'ebibinja ebyali ebweru w'enzigi z'ekkanisa ye — abasenguse Abaitaliya, abakozi ku mwalo, abaavu abatalina kkanisa — abataayinza kuwulira nga bali awaka mu ntebe z'okupangisa ne mu kibiina eky'empisa entongole. Bwe kyeeyoleka nti ekibiina kye tekyalina mugugu ogwo, yava mu buweereza mu Novemba 1881, nga talina musaala era nga talina kibiina kimuwagira, ng'alina mukyala n'abaana mukaaga ab'okuliisa. Margaret Simpson yalowooza nti okusalawo okwo kwali kya ddalu; naye n'ajja n'agabanako omulimu n'omutima gwe gwonna.

Simpson yali alwadde okumala emyaka mingi, ng'alina obulwadde bw'omutima obuzibu ennyo ng'abasawo tebaamuwa ssuubi lingi ery'okweyongera n'omulimu. Mu kyeya ekya 1881, e Old Orchard Beach mu Maine, yawulira ebyawandiikibwa nga bibikkulwa ku buweereza bwa Kristo eri omubiri, era ng'ali yekka wakati w'emiti n'akola endagaano enzito: yatwala Mukama waffe Yesu ng'Omuwonya we, n'asuubiza okukozesa amaanyi gonna ge yandiweereddwa olwa Katonda yekka, era n'asaba obuteddayo kuteebwa mu ndagaano eyo. Obulwadde obw'ebbanga ne buggwaawo, era omuntu abasawo gwe baali bawaddeyo essuubi n'atwala ogumu ku migugu egisinga obuzito egy'omulimu mu byafaayo by'ekkanisa mu Amerika okumala emyaka ng'amakumi ana egirala.

Kye kyekaalirizo kya Simpson ekisinga okumanyibwa, ekyanjula Yesu Kristo ng'Omulokozi, Omutukuza, Omuwonya era Kabaka Ajja — enjuyi nnya ez'Omuntu omu, so si mikisa ena egyawukana. Mu Gospel Tabernacle ye, emisana gy'Olwakutaano gyaweebwanga olukuŋŋaana olw'okuwonya, naye abo abajjanga nga banoonya omukozi w'ebyamagero baalungamizibwanga mpola: Simpson yasabiranga abalwadde ng'amaze okubalaga okuyita ku kirabo ne batunuulira Omugabi, era enkuŋŋaana ezo, okusinga ekintu ekirala kyonna, zaali saawa z'okusinza n'okulindirira Katonda. Omukisa tegwakkirizibwanga kusiikiriza Oyo agaba omukisa.

q: Christian and Missionary Alliance yava mu ki?
a: Mu 1887, e Old Orchard, Simpson yateekawo ebibiina bibiri — ekimu olw'obulamu obw'omwoyo obw'omunda ennyo eka, n'ekirala olw'okubuulira ensi yonna enjiri — ebyegatta mu 1897 ne bifuuka Christian and Missionary Alliance. Yagenderera kibeere kwegatta wakati w'amakanisa, so si ddiini mpya, naye oluvannyuma ne kifuuka ddiini era n'amaanyi ag'obuminsani ku buli ssemazinga, okuva mu China n'India okutuuka mu Amerika ey'Obukiikaddyo n'ekiwonvu kya Kongo. Ensi etannatuukibwako enjiri yamuzitoowerera ng'ennaku ey'omunda; oluyimba lwe olw'obuminsani lukungubagira "emyoyo emitwalo kkumi buli lunaku" egiyingira obulamu obutaggwaawo nga tegifunye njiri.

Mu 1883 yaggulawo Missionary Training Institute — essomero ery'okusooka erya Bayibuli mu Amerika ey'Obukiikakkono, oluvannyuma eryatereera e Nyack ku mugga Hudson — okutegeka abasajja n'abakazi aba bulijjo abeewaayo olw'ennimiro ezo tewali mulala eyandizijjuzza: si bayivu bokka, wabula abawandiisi n'ababazzi ne bannamwandu abaali bawulidde okuyita kwa Katonda. Mu mwaka gwe gumu yatuma ekibinja kye eky'okusooka eky'abaminsani okwolekera Kongo. Teyayinzanga kulaba kyetaago nga tateekawo kintu okukituukiriza, era essomero eryo ne lifuuka ennimiro y'ensigo ey'omukolo kaakano ogubala amakanisa gaagwo mu nkumi.

Eddirisa erisinga obulungi ery'okutegeera Simpson bwe bujulizi bwe yawa e Bethshan, London, mu 1885, obwafulumizibwa okuva olwo nga "Himself" — olugero olw'engeri gye yalekera okunoonya ebyo by'awulira n'azuula buli kimu mu Muntu wa Yesu. Yakiteeka mu bunnyimba: "Edda gwali mukisa, kaakano ye Mukama; Edda kwali kuwulira, kaakano lye Kigambo kye; Edda nnayagala ekirabo kye, kaakano nkkiriza Omugabi; Edda nnanoonya kuwonyezebwa, kaakano Yennyini yekka." Kino kiwumbako obubaka bwe bwonna: si mukisa, si kuwonya, wadde si bulamu obw'omunda ennyo, wabula Kristo Yennyini.

q: Yasobola atya okukola emirimu emingi bwe gityo?
a: Abo abaabeera ne Simpson baagamba nti eyingini y'ebyo byonna yali enkya ennyo — essaawa ezaakuumibwanga n'obuggya olwa Bayibuli n'okwegatta ne Katonda okutali kwanguya. Yawandiika nti ekyama ky'obulamu obw'omunda ennyo kyali "awatukuvu awatono munda," awatwalibwa mu lunaku olusinga okuba n'emirimu emingi, omwoyo we gwebbira mpola okugenda eri Kristo wakati w'emirimu. Okuva mu bulamu obwo obukusike ne muvaamu ebiwandiiko bya buli wiiki, ebitabo eby'okusaba eby'omuwendo nga "Days of Heaven Upon Earth" ne "A Larger Christian Life," ennyinnyonnyola ezissa essira ku Kristo eziyita mu Bayibuli yonna, n'ennyimba ezikyayimbibwa buli we obulamu obw'omunda ennyo we buweebwa ekitiibwa.

q: Yafa atya, era kiki kye yaleka?
a: Simpson yabuulira, yatambula, yawandiika era n'afuga n'amaanyi ge gonna okutuuka mu myaka gye egy'amakumi musanvu, era amaanyi ge bwe gaamuggwaako ku nkomerero, ekyasinga okumunakuwaza kwe kuba nti teyayinza nate kutwala mugugu gw'obuminsani mu kusaba nga bwe kyali edda. Yafiira e Nyack, New York, nga 29 Okitobba 1919, era n'aziikibwa ku lusozi lw'essomero lye yatandikawo. Ebibiina bye yatandika kaakano bibala amakanisa gaabyo mu nkumi n'abaminsani baabyo mu nsi yonna, naye ekijjukizo kye eky'amazima ekisinga ye musomi, mu kifo ekimu mu mpapula ze, akomya okugoberera omukisa n'azuula Oyo agaba omukisa — Yennyini.
